description: This file defines a Java interface 'ThingMessageAdapter' which provides default implementations for methods related to obtaining topic paths and criteria for message handling within the Eclipse Ditto project. It acts as a mixin for adapters handling 'Signal' types associated with 'thing' messages.

classes.name: ThingMessageAdapter
classes.description: A mixin interface for message adapters dealing with 'thing' signals, providing default topic path configurations.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the set containing the 'THINGS' group, indicating this adapter handles 'thing' related messages.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set containing the 'LIVE' channel, indicating the live communication channel.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set containing 'MESSAGES', indicating the criteria for message processing.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an empty set, indicating no specific actions are defined.
